evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 5.2 ppm before growth, consistent with the low post-purge baseline.
O2 rose to 30.9 ppm during growth.
O2 has risen persistently throughout growth, reaching 54.5 ppm despite unchanged argon setpoint.
Temperature is 749.4 °C versus 750 °C setpoint and Ar is 100.6 sccm versus 100 sccm; controller reports running, but these do not resolve the oxygen anomaly.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth-stage pressure.

args.missing_evidence: Obtain an independent tube-pressure measurement and validate the O2 reading; check seal integrity and exhaust patency to distinguish air ingress from other atmosphere or sensor faults. Sample characterization is not yet available.
